_comment: Full device boot configuration used by every current image (GPU280 / cell / USB builds): build.py all|boot --boot-config x9/build/boot-device.json. boot.json carries only the base arguments. Recovered byte-exact from x9-gpu280-purge-20261112.
_comment_defaults: Proven kernel feature switches are default-on (sweet_x9_arg); pass name=0 to disable. x9_submit_async/x9_gpu_park became default-on 2026-11-13 (freed 32 B for per-image tokens). x9_metal_render=1 stays because X9GeneralMetal reads kern.bootargs. dv=1 is the x9_dvfsrc=1 alias; ug=5 negotiates UFS max<=G5.
